digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and bug-review tier
propositions: The guide does not clearly explain that bugs may be claimed without plan review to perform RCA first, creating ambiguity about whether bugs are always exempt or never exempt from plan review.
After RCA yields an implementation plan and recorded file impact for a complex bug, the guide must state that LLM plan review is required before remediation begins, not permanently exempt.

The claim-time exemption (CLI gate) and implementation-time LLM review requirement (post-RCA for complex bugs) are separate axes that must be explicitly distinguished in documentation to resolve reader confusion.
Existing behavioral code in gates.py and bug-review tier tests establish the authoritative exemption and escalation behavior and must not be changed; only documentation needs correction.
